India suffers series defeat to England in T20 cricket

England secured a dominant 4-0 series victory over India in a T20 cricket series. England posted a large total of 257 runs in the fifth match, with notable partnerships and strong batting performances. India's bowlers struggled significantly, and the team's fielding was described as sub-standard, with dropped catches and lost wickets contributing to the defeat. Following the series loss, the Indian cricket board announced a review of the T20 team's performance. Some reports suggest a potential overhaul of coaching staff.
